verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Insomnia sends requests over HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSockets. gRPC has dedicated docs (request creation, Protobuf upload), and GraphQL gets schema-based auto-completion and linting. SSE is not mentioned anywhere in the evidence, so one of the four named protocols is unsupported by the pack. missing for 10: SSE request support, dedicated WebSocket documentation depth, independent hands-on corroboration of non-REST protocols.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, and SSE requests, not just REST

citations.quote: With Insomnia, you can send requests via HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSockets.
Insomnia supports making gRPC requests. You can create one by clicking the + button on the left panel of a collection and selecting gRPC Request.
Insomnia allows you to upload Protobuf files to a request.
Insomnia uses this type system to provide auto-completion and linting of GraphQL queries.
